note: Boundary few-shot set (fewshot_boundary). Chosen mainly from governance and critical boundary cases in data/coding.csv, covering both sides of 0/1 and 1/2 on those two dimensions, plus conceptual 1 and applied 1 vs 2. Scores are copied exactly from data/coding.csv. Evidence quotes are verbatim sentences from each call. No exemplar is conceptual 0. These uids are held out from evaluation.

exemplars.call_title: Credit Corp Group Limited - Shareholder/Analyst Call
exemplars.sentences:

•  In terms of AI to date, investments, expenditures on large language models and the team involved, it's probably running at about $1.5 million per annum.
•  Look, in some ways, AI is something you can't ignore because your competitors will do it, and someone will find a way to make it work.
•  So look, at the moment, all of our AI initiatives, a particular sort of governance overlay that is being put in place is that they all involve what's called human in the loop.
•  So it may be that if somebody is having a dialogue, a digital interaction, it may be that the automated agent, the AI might draft the communication, but it will always be reviewed and potentially adjusted by a human before it's deployed.

conceptual: So the large language models are much better at transcribing and monitoring sentiment on these customer interactions.
applied: We have a dedicated AI implementation team that is focused on it alongside our operational teams.
governance: So look, at the moment, all of our AI initiatives, a particular sort of governance overlay that is being put in place is that they all involve what's called human in the loop.

exemplars.note: Human codes in data/coding.csv: conceptual 1, critical 0, applied 1, governance 1. Governance 1 boundary (one safeguard). A single human-in-the-loop review rule on AI drafts is a brief safeguard, so governance is 1, not 2. Critical is 0: 'AI is something you can't ignore' is not an evaluation of the AI system. Conceptual 1 and applied 1: a model capability and a stated use, with no measured outcome.
exemplars.selection_reason: governance 0/1 and 1/2 boundary: single human-in-the-loop safeguard

exemplars.call_title: CyberArk Software Ltd., Q4 2024 Earnings Call, Feb 13, 2025
exemplars.sentences:

•  And ultimately, when you take both the tools we offer around dynamic secure access on the human side and the machine identity offerings in our solution set, you combine them together, we can actually take agentic AI, take those agents themselves and make sure that they're secured as their privilege changes in a dynamic environment.

conceptual: When artificial intelligence evolves from generative AI and copilots to agents with the autonomy to complete tasks on a user's behalf, they can create their own automations entirely.
applied: Leveraging AI-driven role management, Zilla automates the processes of identity compliance and provisioning, making governance easy, intuitive and all-inclusive for the modern enterprise.
governance: Like humans, AI agents will need the right level of privilege controls.
And fourth, securing against AI and the securing of AI are soon to be among the biggest challenges we will all face.

exemplars.note: Human codes in data/coding.csv: conceptual 2, critical 0, applied 1, governance 2. Governance 2 on the human codes: the speaker develops how AI systems and AI agents themselves must be secured and given privilege controls, across several connected points. Critical is 0 on the human codes: calling securing AI a big challenge is framed as a market need, not an evaluation of AI reliability or readiness. Conceptual 2 for the connected reasoning from generative AI to autonomous agents and machine identities. Applied 1.
exemplars.selection_reason: governance 1/2 boundary (2 side) and critical 0 side (baseline: governance 0, critical 1)
